matter: Aurora Grid Systems LLC v. Heltex Energy Corp. (fictional)

preamble.text: A thermal management system for a battery module, the system comprising:

limitations.text: a coolant channel defined through a stack of prismatic cells
a temperature sensor array disposed on at least two faces of the stack
a controller configured to modulate coolant flow based on the temperature sensor array
a pressure-relief valve in fluid communication with the coolant channel.

setA.text: 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the coolant is a dielectric fluid.

limitations.text: wherein the coolant is a dielectric fluid.

setA.text: 3. The system of claim 1, wherein the controller derates the stack when any sensor exceeds a threshold; and wherein the derating persists for at least five minutes.

limitations.text: wherein the controller derates the stack when any sensor exceeds a threshold
wherein the derating persists for at least five minutes.

preamble.text: A thermal management system for a battery module, the system comprising:

limitations.text: a coolant channel defined through a stack of prismatic cells
a temperature sensor array disposed on at least two faces of the stack
a controller configured to modulate coolant flow based on the temperature sensor array and a discharge threshold
a pressure-relief valve in fluid communication with the coolant channel.

setB.text: 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the coolant is a dielectric fluid and includes a corrosion inhibitor.

limitations.text: wherein the coolant is a dielectric fluid and includes a corrosion inhibitor.

setB.text: 4. The system of claim 1, wherein the pressure-relief valve opens at a cracking pressure below 3 bar.
